(Jewish Telegraph Agency).—The government yesterday made public a compensation scale for the Palestine riots of last Summer which provides no compensation for the deaths of persons under 14 years of age. Persons between 14 and 18 who were killed are worth a maximum of SSOO in compensation. A wife whose husband was killed Is entitled to a maximum of $1,250, while a husband whose wife was killed gets only SSOO.
